name: Starter: coding
description: The default wheel: everyday prompts for coding with AI.

slots.label: Code review
slots.prompt: Review this code for bugs, edge cases and readability. List issues from most to least severe, each with a suggested fix.

slots.label: Debug
slots.prompt: Here is an error. Explain the root cause in plain terms, then give the smallest change that fixes it.

slots.label: Write tests
slots.prompt: Write focused tests for this code. Cover the happy path, edge cases and one failure case. Match the existing test style.

slots.label: Simplify
slots.prompt: Simplify this code without changing its behavior. Remove duplication and dead code, and keep names clear.

slots.label: Plan first
slots.prompt: Before writing any code, outline your plan: the files you will touch, the approach, and any open questions for me.

slots.label: Explain
slots.prompt: Explain what this code does as if I'm new to the codebase. Start with the big picture, then walk through the key parts.

slots.label: Commit msg
slots.prompt: Write a concise git commit message for these changes: a short summary line, then a few bullet points.

slots.label: Be concise
slots.prompt: Keep your answer short and direct. Lead with the result, skip the preamble.
